note: Bets EVERY moneyline grade v2 A+ offer to verify the grade's ongoing profitability (until now the grade was a label and its record only covered bets other tracks placed). Basis: output/research/grade_v2.md, strategy S1_Aplus_flat (frozen before the holdout): 2023-25 one-shot holdout A+ CLV +2.34% +- 0.98 (p 0.009), 163 bets (~54/season), ROI +22% +- 15; dev 2020-22 +4.16% +- 0.92 on 89. 2023-25 was also the holdout of earlier studies, so the 2026 season is the clean test. Do not edit to fit results; bump version instead.
grade: grade_v2.py (GRADING_VERSION 2, frozen grade_v2_model.json): A+ = predicted CLV >= +2.5% of the best allowed-book price of the side with the highest predicted CLV (game['grade_v2'])

qualify.window_note: research candidate table (ml_spread_consistency.build_ml): snapshots 10 min .. 7 days before kickoff
qualify.lock: One bet per game at the FIRST snapshot where the game's best offer is A+, at that offer's book and price; later snapshots never change it. Snapshots = every full run (pipeline update) AND every hourly odds watch (pipeline watch). The research looked only at our historical run times (sparser), so more looks can only find more A+ moments: expect somewhat more bets than the research rate and judge the result on 2026 lines.
qualify.bet: the graded side at the book and price that were graded A+; no other conditions (no QB/injury-report eligibility, no price range beyond the grade's own candidate filter)

validation.clv_definition: bets.grade: bet decimal odds x nflverse closing no-vig probability of that side - 1 (as moneyline v1/v2)
